---
title: "Streaming completion of the large static Excel table"
format: html
---

The artifact runtime authored the workbook, all styles and the rendered opening
view of every table. Two large-range attempts did not complete in practical time
(the first exceeded nine minutes). This streaming OOXML step supplies only the
large static table body. It preserves every other workbook entry unchanged.
No spreadsheet formulas or statistical calculations are introduced.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import json,zipfile,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from xml.sax.saxutils import escape
out=Path('/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived/supplementary_workbook_2026-09-22-v1')
ns='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('',ns)
d=json.loads((out/'S8.json').read_text())
with zipfile.ZipFile(out/'workbook_template.xlsx') as z:
 wb=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
 sh=next(x for x in wb.find('{'+ns+'}sheets') if x.attrib['name']==d['sheet'])
 rid=sh.attrib['{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id']
 rels=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
 target=next(x.attrib['Target'] for x in rels if x.attrib['Id']==rid)
 member=target.lstrip('/') if target.startswith('/') else 'xl/'+target
 root=ET.fromstring(z.read(member));sd=root.find('{'+ns+'}sheetData')
 header=ET.tostring(sd[0],encoding='utf-8')
 styles={c.attrib['r'].rstrip('0123456789'):c.attrib.get('s') for c in sd[1]}
 sd.clear()
 dim=root.find('{'+ns+'}dimension')
 if dim is not None:dim.attrib['ref']=f'A1:P{len(d["rows"])+1}'
 template=ET.tostring(root,encoding='utf-8')
 before,after=template.split(b'<sheetData />')
 with zipfile.ZipFile(out/'Supplementary_Tables.xlsx','w',compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=6,allowZip64=True) as dest:
  for info in z.infolist():
   if info.filename!=member:dest.writestr(info,z.read(info.filename))
  with dest.open(member,'w',force_zip64=True) as f:
   f.write(before+b'<sheetData>'+header)
   for i,row in enumerate(d['rows'],2):
    cells=[]
    for j,v in enumerate(row):
     col=chr(65+j);ref=f'{col}{i}';style=f' s="{styles[col]}"' if styles.get(col) else ''
     if isinstance(v,(int,float)) and not isinstance(v,bool):cell=f'<c r="{ref}"{style}><v>{v!r}</v></c>'
     elif isinstance(v,bool):cell=f'<c r="{ref}"{style} t="b"><v>{int(v)}</v></c>'
     else:
      assert all(ord(c)>=32 or c in '\t\n\r' for c in v)
      cell=f'<c r="{ref}"{style} t="inlineStr"><is><t xml:space="preserve">{escape(v)}</t></is></c>'
     cells.append(cell)
    f.write((f'<row r="{i}">'+''.join(cells)+'</row>').encode())
   f.write(b'</sheetData>'+after)
with zipfile.ZipFile(out/'Supplementary_Tables.xlsx') as z:assert z.testzip() is None
print('Streaming completion and ZIP integrity check passed')
```
